note: Quest rewards that also drop in duties, so they are not exclusive to the quest. Keyed by the reward item's Item row id. source names the other place (DungeonDrop: the item drops in a dungeon); where names the duties as the Lodestone item page's Obtained From lists them, and the plugin shows it as "Also drops in" followed by that text. DataGen marks every unique_quests.json entry delivered as the item with otherSources DungeonDrop and copies where into otherSourceNotes; the plugin shows those rows as "Also drops" and can hide them. Source: docs/data/verification-full.md (T2a, Discrepancies to fix), where the Lodestone item page and the wiki both list the duties. Strict JSON; keep sorted by item id; every entry needs name, source, where, evidence and note.
